tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (tha)༄༅/ /sbyin sreg bsdus pa phrin las rin po che'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /ye shes me lce 'phro tsam gyis/ /sdig sgrib tshang
(tha)༄༅/ /sbyin sreg bsdus pa phrin las rin po che'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /ye shes me lce 'phro tsam gyis/ /sdig sgrib tshang

tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// sbyin sreg bsdus pa phrin las rin po che'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// ye shes me lce 'phro tsam gyis// sdig sgrib tshang tshing kun sreg pa'i// bla ma me lhar gus btud nas// sbyin sreg cho ga bsdus te bri// de la 'dir las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bsdus pa bya ba la/ thog mar sngags kyi lhag chad dang*/ sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa sogs nye bar sbyang ba'i slad zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ rnam par 'dul ba'i gnas su sa stegs ngos mnyam par thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas mtho gang gi tshad kyis zlum por bskor bas khru gang 'byung ba ni zab kyi nang ngo*// de'i phyi rol tu'ang sor bzhi pa lan gnyis kyis bskor bas kha sgyer dang mu ran 'byung*/ dbus nas tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzom pa'i bar gyi srad bu des zur bzhir bya rjes byas te stegs bu gru bzhir gdab/ de'i phyi rol tu'ang sor bzhi pa'i tshad kyis cha kha gru bzhir gdab pa ni stegs bu dpangs mtshon byed yin gsungs/ mu ran la rdo rje kha zum pa'i phreng ba dang*/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rtse nang bstan bri/ gzhi tshon thams cad dkar po la bcad rnams ci mdzes su bya/ phal che ba la thab dbus nas sum gcig gis bskor ba pad+ma'i lte ba dang*/ de'i phyi sum gnyis la pad+ma'i 'dab ma bya zhing*/ de'i tshab tu lha'i bskyed chog gi dbye bas pad 'dab rim can dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ chos 'byung dang*/ gzhal yas khang sogs gang dgos kyi thig lag len bzhin btab la lha du yod kyi phyag mtshan nam/ sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon phung bya zhing gtso bo'i zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub tu bstan/ bya btang lta bu bud shing cher med pa dang*/ gnas khang sogs kyis ma bde na gong du smros pa'i cha tshad phyed phyed phri ba las 'os med do// bud shing 'o ma can gyi shing dngos 'byor dka' bas bal bu/

'om bu/ lcang dkar/ nya 'phrig lta bu dang*/ srog chags med pa'i lci ba skam pos kyang rung bas kha sgyer gyi steng nas zlum por brtsig de'i nang gi 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor me tshang gi ting lo bzhag thab kyi mdun du sgrub pa po'i stan dkar po bting ba'i mdun du stegs kyi khar rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba dang*/ g.yas ngos su dung phor dri bzang gi chus bkang ba ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa'i bsang chu/ bla med yin na g.yon ngos su nang mchod kyang bsham/ grub na me yol kyang bzhag ste gangs ti ser bsgom/ rdzas ni/ sgrub pa po'i g.yas logs kyi stegs la rim bzhin yam shing gong du smos pa'i shing las sor bcu gnyis pa rtsi ma nyams pa rtsa rtse sbrang ngam mar gyis sbags pa grangs du dgos dang*/ mar khu/ til nag ste rdzas kyi gtso bo gsum gyis chog 'byor zhing spro na zas mchog nas ku sha'i bar gyi rdzas brgyad kyang bsham/ g.yon ngos su gtor ma gnyis dang mchod pa tshan gnyis bsham/ rdzas kyang tshan pa gnyis bshams na legs mod/ snod ma 'byor na me lha la 'bul skabs/ phud cung zad re phris nas 'das pa la 'bul rgyur bsre/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang dpal 'bar la sogs pa 'du bya ba ni sbyor ba'i chos so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ phyed ma red kyi dus su gos stan dkar po dang kha shar du phyogs pas skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor rang rang gi sgrub thabs bzhin nyams su blang ngo*// de nas bsang chu la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas pas chu nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ rgyun bzhag gi me las dpal 'bar sbar te lag pa gnyis kas thab la zlum por bskor zhing*/ ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod cing thab nang gi ting lo sbar la rtswa skam po sogs kyis gso/ blugs gzar gyis mar khu khyab par blug me pra brtag ngan na hūm̐ gis bsang chu gtor bas zhi bar bya/

de nas bsang chu mchod rdzas rnams la gtor zhing las sngags sam a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon la sogs pa'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang*/ yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā nas shab+da swā hā'i bar brjod/ bla med yin na ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las sogs brjod/ de bzhin du chu gcig gsum bzhi lta bu yin tshe rang ming dang sngags so so'i lugs bzhin brje/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs bdag bskyed kyi skabs su yod na des 'thus la/ med na skabs 'dir byin rlabs rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa tsam gyis sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i sa bon rnams zhu ba'i bdud rtsir bsam/ gang ltar yang mchod yon gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrī swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hās til sogs 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyangs te byin gyis brlab/ bsdu na oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan kha yar brjod pas 'grub bo// thab sngar bzhin bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa/ kha sgyer dang bcas shing mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang ba/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes spras pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las me lha sku mdog dkar po ra skyes la zhon pa/

zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis kyis dbyu gu rtse gsum dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ zhes pa tsam mam/ so so'i lugs bzhin tshul mi 'dra ba dang*/ skye mched byin rlabs/ go cha sogs gang 'os dgod/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing rol mo dbul/ bla med yin na nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod de ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams te/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge// sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la bgegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig /ces dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa a zhes lan brgyad brjod cing thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgram mo// me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐/ de las 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba dgang blugs kyi kha'i ram̐ la phog pas mar khu gsol bar bsam zhing*/ byang chub mchog gi khu tshur gyis dgang blugs gzar bzung nas/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī pyā ma hā shrī ye ha be ka be ba ha nā ya swā hā/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dang*/ sgo gsum gyi nad gdon nyer 'tshe thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes pa'am/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong yin tshe/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gzar bu kha sbyar la dbul/ de lta bu lan gsum song ba dang*/ yam shing lag pa g.yon du bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis re re nas blangs te cung zad bskor zhing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pas phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sogs spel tshig sngar ltar gang 'os brjod/ de'i rigs 'gre shes par byas la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pas mar dang*/

oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pas til dbul/ 'phral gyi gnod pa zhi ba tsam la til gyi tshab yungs kar gyis kyang rung ste zhib par 'og tu 'chad/ zas mchog la sogs pa'i rdzas brgyad po yod na/ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ 'bras la oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ so ba la/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/ nas la/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ gro la/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ dūrba la/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ ku sha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams so so'i mthar gong ltar gyi spel tshig sbyar bas dbul/ yam shing la sogs pa 'di rnams rang rang gi sngags lan gsum re sngon du btang nas/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa'i lha sngags kho nas phul yang rung*/ slar yang gong ltar mchod bstod byas la mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par bsam pa yan chad ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'i cho ga'o// de nas me 'bar ba'i dbus su lha bskyed par bya ste/ so so'i mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba bzhin rten pad+ma tsam mam/ 'khor lo/ chos 'byung dang*/ srung 'khor/ dur khrod/ gzhal yas khang sogs gang yin pa pam̐ dang*/ hūm̐ dang*/ bh+rūm̐ sogs rang rang gi sa bon tsam las bskyed/ brten pa lha du yod pa sa bon tsam mam/ rdo rje'i cho ga gsum las bskyed cing spyi bor rigs bdag bsam pa'i bar ma 'chol bar bya zhing*/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe spro na spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can sogs sh+lo ka gcig gam gsum gyi mthar mtshan sngags la e h+ye hi btags pa brjod/ zhi ba'i las la gtso bo'i rigs bdag rnam snang du bsgyur ba'am ma bsgyur kyang rung*/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo de rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med du bsam/ de'i mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs mgron thabs su 'khod par dmigs la/

lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po spro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam/ skabs 'dir yang me pra brtag pa 'ga' res bshad do// de nas gzar bu gnyis sngar bzhin bzung ste/ lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i sogs dang*/ gtso bo'i snying po lan gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa lan bdun dang mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī byā sogs spel tshig dang bcas pa gong ltar brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha thams cad kyi zhal du dus gcig la phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pas byon skyems dbul/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs te/ 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad yod pa rnams la de ka dang*/ med pa rnams la mchod yon phal cher ma'am/ 'jig rten khams ni ma'am/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma gang shes 'don pa bsgyur zhing chu gnyis sam bzhi sogs gang yin rang ming brje ba'i tshul gyis 'bul/ rgyud sde 'og ma rnams la spro na rin chen bdun sogs spyi ltar phul kyang chog bla med rnams la nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang*/ gsang ba snyoms 'jug gi mchod pa dang*/ gzhan yang yid byung mchod pa rnams so so'i gzhung nas bshad tshod ltar bya/ gzhan ma bshad cing ma shes na'ang lha so so'i snying po'am/ sa bon nam/ mtshan sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod cis kyang phul/ rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci shes pas bstod/ de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i rdzas gang yod sde tshan re re'i mgor gtso bo'i snying po gang yin pa tshar gsum re brjod cing*/ oṃ bo dhi pṛk+ṣā ya swā hā sogs rdzas sngags rnams brgya rtsa re nges par dbul zhing so so'i mthar spel tshig gong ltar brjod do// yang na rdzas sngags lan gsum re sngon du 'gro bas lha sngags brgya rtsas 'bul ba'ang bshad pas gang mos bya/

'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ 'phral gyi rim gror byed na snga ma ltar dang*/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong yin na phyi ma ltar bya bar bshad mod/ gtso bor thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub na snga ma ltar dang*/ mchog gi dngos grub la dmigs na phyi ma ltar bya'o// phyi ma 'di la gtso bo'i snying po tsam gyis gtso 'khor thams cad la dus gcig la 'bul ba dang*/ gtso bo la brgya rtsa spel tshig bcas song ba dang*/ rdzas sngags lan gsum gyis thog drangs te 'khor gyi sngags rnams tshar gsum re sbrel ba'i mthar spel tshig brjod pas 'bul ba'ang yod de rang gi 'byor pa dang long skabs bstun te bya/ de nas bsnyen pa'i kha skong yin na til kho na la grangs bzung ste lha sngags bsnyen pa'i bcu cha 'bul dgos pas nyin re'i khongs su gang 'gro'i tshul gyis nyin grangs ji tsam dgos pa bya/ rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang nyams chag bskang ba'i ched yin na'ang til kho nas bya zhing*/ gdon bgegs kyi gnod 'tshe zhi ba tsam la til gyi tshab yungs kar gyis bya ba dang*/ sngags sarba pā paṃ sogs kyi tshab tu/ bgegs la oṃ sarba bigh+nān da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ gdon la sarba duṣ+ṭan da ha na sogs dang*/ nad la sarba rog rims la sarba dz+wa ra/ nye bar 'tshe ba la sarba u pa dra wa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu/ rmi lam ngan pa la sarba dur swap+na/ ltas ngan la/ sarba durni mit+ta/ rnam par g.yeng ba la/ oṃ sarba tsit+ta ku la da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā zhes pa lta bur bsgyur/ grangs ji tsam nus pas chog la spel tshig bod skad kyang brjod cing skabs skabs su me gso ba'i don du bud shing dang mar yang ci rigs pa gzhug go /de la yam shing ni gzi brjid bskyed pa'i ched du me 'od la/ zhu ba'i rdzas mar khu dang*/ til dang zas mchog yod na'ang zhal du'o// gong bu'i rdzas 'bru sna tshogs 'bul na phyag tu/ ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug tor la phul bar bsam mo// 'bru sna dang dūrba'ang bdud rtsir bzhus te zhal du bstab par bzhed pa'ang yod 'dra/

gang ltar yang mthar bsdu ran pa na byon zan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems kyi tshul du dbul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i mchod yon la sogs pa rang rang lugs ltar gyis mchod/ bla med yin na nang mchod kyang phul te bstod pa bsdus pas bstod/ gtor ma bran la rang rang gi lugs bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ gtor sngags lan gsum mam lngas thab kyi lha la dbul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang*/ gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad ces sogs kyi mthar oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi thal ba cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam pa yan ni ye shes pa'i me lha mchod pa'i cho ga ste dngos gzhi'i chos so// gsum pa rjes ni/ slar yang mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg par blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes pas me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsam/ bsreg rdzas kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs ci 'byor pa phul ba'i mthar byon zan gyi skabs su smos pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems kyi tshul du dbul/ yon bdag la sogs pa'i ched du yin na spel tshig gi tshe de'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dgang gzar dang lhan cig tu bzung la/ bdag cag dpon slob yon bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba'i nad dang gdon dang bkra mi shis pa dang*/

byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes bdun tshan gsum po re re'i mthar bya'o// me lha'i gtor ma chab kyis bran la bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs gsum mam lngas dbul/ mchod bstod gong du bshad pa ltar bya zhing*/ spro na/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras zhes sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba'i bstod pa'ang bya/ thal mo sbyar te/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag gi tshe 'khor ba sogs 'das pa'i me lha'i skabs bzhin gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya bzla zhing bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha zhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang gi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// rgyud sde 'og ma yin na skabs 'dir cha gsum gtor ma spyi ltar gtang ba'am ma grub kyang 'gal ba cher med/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung ba'am/ skye mched bsrung ba/ go cha dgod pa la sogs bdag bskyed kyi mjug sdud rang rang gi lugs bzhin byas la smon lam dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci shes pa brjod/ mchog gi dngos grub kyi ched du yin na me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul/ thun mong ba tsam la long med na me 'o mas bcil la thal ba phyags pa'i shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/ me tog gtor ba ni rjes kyi chos so// de nyid gzhir bzhag nas rgyas pa'i khyad par thab khung ser po gru bzhi pa/

mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan pa bri/ ser zhing dri zhim pa 'bras bu can gyi yam shing khru gang pa/ khyad par gyi rdzas dūrba sogs/ gos gdan ser po/ dus snga dro/ kha byang du bltas nas khyel 'dug byas te/ rgyal po'i khyim gyi mes spar/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po gru bzhi pa rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa/ kha sgyer dang bcas shing mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan pa sogs dang*/ me lha sku mdog ser po sogs nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbur brgyan zhes bsgyur/ spel tshig ni/ tshe rgyas pa la/ bdag gam sbyin bdag gi ā yuḥpuṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ bsod nams rgyas pa la puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dpal 'byor la shrī bhū ti puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ shes rab la pradzñā puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes pa lta bu blos dpyad de sbyar/ yang na bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa blo dang spobs pa rnam par grol ba'i ye shes thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes pas 'thus/ khyad par gyi rdzas oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa me lha rang gi sngags kyi dbul/ 'das pa'i me lha'i gtso bo'i rigs bdag rin chen 'byung ldan du bsgyur ba'am ma bsgyur kyang rung*/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing tshim pa'i nyams can gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ 'od zer ser po spro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i las mdzad par bsam/ bsreg rdzas rnams grangs brgya rtsa brgyad re nges par dbul zhing*/ dūrba sogs khyad par gyi rdzas gang yin kyang gtso bo'i snying pos mtshon lha sngags kho nas dbul/ rdzas grangs 'dzin rgyu dūrba sogs gang 'os bya zhing brgya rtsa brgyad re'i mtshams su spel tshig sbyar/ 'dod don zhu ba gong 'og gi tshe/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa blo dang spobs pa rnam par grol ba'i ye shes thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ thal ba 'phral du 'phyag dgos na gur gum gyi chus gzhil ba tsam ni khyad par ro// zhi ba gzhir bzhag nas dbang la thab khung dmar po zla gam/ mu ran la lcags kyu'i phreng ba bri/ dmar zhing skyur ba'i yam shing sor brgyad pa/ khyad par gyi rdzas me tog dmar po/ gos gdan dmar po/ dus phyi dro/ kha nub bltas/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ smad 'tshong ma'i mes sbar/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i dbang gi thab khung dmar po zla gam rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa/ kha sgyer dang bcas shing mu ran la lcags kyu'i phreng bas mtshan pa zhes sogs dang*/ me lha sku mdog dmar po sogs nas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes brjod/ spel tshig ni/ rgyal po yul 'khor paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa stobs ldan 'byor ldan shes ldan gyi 'gro ba thams cad wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes brjod/ rdzas lnga bcu tham pa/ gong 'og gi 'dod gsol rnams dbang gi bya'o// zhi ba gzhir bzhag nas drag po la thab khung nag po gru gsum sum rim/ mu ran la rdo rje kha gdengs pa'i phreng ba/ nag cing rtsub pa'i yam shing sor bcu pa/ khyad par gyi rdzas ke tshe/ shang tshe/ yungs dkar nag khrag sna/ dug sna/ lcags phye zangs phye bcas gang 'dzom bsres pa/ gos gdan nag po/ dus nam phyed/ kha lhor blta/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ shan pa'i khyim gyi mes sbar/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i drag po'i thab khung nag po gru gsum pa rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa/ kha sgyer dang bcas shing mu ran la rdo rje rtse gsum pa rwa gdengs pas mtshan pa zhes sogs dang*/ me lha sku mdog nag po rab tu khros pa ra skyes la zhon pa sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes dang*/ spel tshig bstan pa dang sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/ bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdo ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa ces pa'am/ bdag gis lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa ces skabs su gang bab brjod/

rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas 'bul ba sogs kun spyod thams cad go ldog khyad par gyi rdzas oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa'am/ oṃ sarba sha tūṃ bigh+nān ma rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas dbul/ rdzas rnams drug cu tham pa re 'bul zhing khyad par gyi rdzas lha sngags gang yin pa des dbul/ gsol gdab drag po'i bya'o// gzhan sgrub pa po'i bsam pa/ lha'i nyams dang kha dog so so'i 'od zer spro bsdu/ dgang blugs 'dzin pa'i khu tshur gyi khyad par/ me gzhil ba'i chu rnams las so sor ma 'dres par bya ba gnad do// sdig sgrib ma lus sreg pa dang*// sngags kyi nus pa 'byin pa'i phyir// sbyin sreg snying po dril bkod dges// 'gro rnams las sgrib byang gyur cig /ces pa'ang sgrub thabs rin po che'i zhal skong du blo gter dbang pos bris pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
